lines.text: Satan incited David to take a census, so David told Joab to count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan.
Joab reported 1,100,000 men who drew the sword, but he did not count Levi and Judah.
Through Gad, the LORD offered David three options, and David chose to fall into the LORD's hand, so a plague killed seventy thousand.
The LORD told the destroying angel to stop, and David saw the angel by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite with a drawn sword over Jerusalem.
David paid Ornan six hundred shekels of silver for the site, built an altar, and the LORD answered with fire.
